title: Visitors are told the Collective $99 Founding price ends January 1, from one constant that also closes the offer

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20: make sure people realize the beta pricing offer on Collective ends Jan 1.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20 (ADR-1812). PREMISE RE-TESTED: the $99 intro is a standing per-item offer (FOUNDING_OPEN_ITEMS), read by the checkout and every price surface, and it does not read beta_grace (Dec 1). Added COLLECTIVE_FOUNDING_ENDS_AT and COLLECTIVE_FOUNDING_ENDS_LABEL; foundingOpenFor closes the offer at that instant; the shared FOUNDING_RATE_NOTE (pricing cards, plan ladder where Collective checkout starts), the pricing FAQ, funnel copy, what-is-Frequency template and two help articles name the date.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/beta.ts','utf8');const miss=[];if(!b.includes('export const COLLECTIVE_FOUNDING_ENDS_AT'))miss.push('no end constant');if(!/FOUNDING_RATE_NOTE = [^\\n]*COLLECTIVE_FOUNDING_ENDS_LABEL/.test(b))miss.push('note lacks the end date');if(!b.includes('collectiveFoundingOpen(now)'))miss.push('foundingOpenFor ignores the end');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-995: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
